See [Contributing](https://github.com/influxdb-rs/influxdb-rust/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/influxdb-rs/influxdb-rust/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). For a list of past changes, see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/influxdb-rs/influxdb-rust/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
2//!
3//! ## Currently Supported Features
4//!
5//! -   Reading and writing to InfluxDB
6//! -   Optional Serde support for deserialization
7//! -   Running multiple queries in one request (e.g. `SELECT * FROM weather_berlin; SELECT * FROM weather_london`)
8//! -   Writing single or multiple measurements in one request (e.g. `WriteQuery` or `Vec<WriteQuery>` argument)
9//! -   Authenticated and unauthenticated connections
10//! -   `async`/`await` support
11//! -   `#[derive(InfluxDbWriteable)]` derive macro for writing / reading into structs
12//! -   `GROUP BY` support
13//! -   Tokio and async-std support (see example below) or [available backends](https://github.com/influxdb-rs/influxdb-rust/blob/main/influxdb/Cargo.toml)
14//! -   Swappable HTTP backends ([see below](#Choice-of-HTTP-backend))
15//!
16//! # Quickstart
17//!
18//! Add the following to your `Cargo.toml`
19#![doc = cargo_toml!(indent="", "derive")]
20//!
21//! For an example with using Serde deserialization, please refer to [serde_integration](crate::integrations::serde_integration)
22//!
23//! ```rust,no_run
24//! use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
25//! use influxdb::{Client, Error, InfluxDbWriteable, ReadQuery, Timestamp};
26//!
27//! #[tokio::main]
28//! async fn main() -> Result<(), Error> {
29//!     // Connect to db `test` on `http://localhost:8086`
30//!     let client = Client::new("http://localhost:8086", "test");
31//!
32//!     #[derive(InfluxDbWriteable)]
33//!     struct WeatherReading {
34//!         time: DateTime<Utc>,
35//!         humidity: i32,
36//!         #[influxdb(tag)]
37//!         wind_direction: String,
38//!     }
39//!
40//!     // Let's write some data into a measurement called `weather`
41//!     let weather_readings = vec![
42//!         WeatherReading {
43//!             time: Timestamp::Hours(1).try_into().unwrap(),
44//!             humidity: 30,
45//!             wind_direction: String::from("north"),
46//!         }
47//!         .try_into_query("weather")
48//!         .unwrap(),
49//!         WeatherReading {
50//!             time: Timestamp::Hours(2).try_into().unwrap(),
51//!             humidity: 40,
52//!             wind_direction: String::from("west"),
53//!         }
54//!         .try_into_query("weather")
55//!         .unwrap(),
56//!     ];
57//!
58//!     client.query(weather_readings).await?;
59//!
60//!     // Read back all records
61//!     let read_query = ReadQuery::new("SELECT * FROM weather");
62//!
63//!     let read_result = client.query(read_query).await?;
64//!     println!("{}", read_result);
65//!     Ok(())
66//! }
67//! ```
68//!
69//! For further examples, check out the integration tests in `tests/integration_tests.rs`
70//! in the repository.
71//!
72//! # Choice of HTTP backend
73//!
74//! To communicate with InfluxDB, you can choose the HTTP backend to be used configuring the appropriate feature. We recommend sticking with the default reqwest-based client, unless you really need async-std compatibility.
75//!
76//! - **[hyper](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper)** (through reqwest, used by default), with [rustls](https://github.com/ctz/rustls)
77#![doc = cargo_toml!(indent="\t", "derive")]
78//! - **[hyper](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper)** (through reqwest), with native TLS (OpenSSL)
79#![doc = cargo_toml!(indent="\t", default-features = false, "derive", "serde", "native-tls")]
80//! - **[hyper](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper)** (through reqwest), with vendored native TLS (OpenSSL)
81#![doc = cargo_toml!(indent="\t", default-features = false, "derive", "serde", "native-tls-vendored")]

87macro_rules! cargo_toml {
88    (indent=$indent:literal, $firstfeat:literal $(, $feature:literal)*) => {
89        cargo_toml_private!($indent, "", $firstfeat $(, $feature)*)
90    };
91
92    (indent=$indent:literal, default-features = false, $firstfeat:literal $(, $feature:literal)*) => {
93        cargo_toml_private!($indent, "default-features = false, ", $firstfeat $(, $feature)*)
94    };
95}
96use cargo_toml;
97
98macro_rules! cargo_toml_private {
99    ($indent:literal, $deffeats:literal, $firstfeat:literal $(, $feature:literal)*) => {
100        concat!(
101            $indent,
102            "```toml\n",
103
104            $indent,
105            "influxdb = { version = \"",
106            env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
107            "\", ",
108            $deffeats,
109            "features = [",
110            "\"", $firstfeat, "\"",
111            $(", \"", $feature, "\"",)*
112            "] }\n",
113
114            $indent,
115            "```"
116        )
117    };
118}
